title: Cargo Capacity Grew Sixfold While Crews Shrunk
hook: Cargo ships carry 6 times more while using smaller crews.
closing: The goods you buy now ride on giant ships operated by remarkably small crews.
question: Would you crew this ship?

segments.say: The largest cargo ship carries 24,327 containers, turning one voyage into a moving distribution hub.
The largest cargo ship is 400 meters long, making today's vessels far larger than famous ocean liners.
A cargo crew is now just 20 people, even as the ships they operate became much larger.
